name: Hamura Ryou
source:
The game’s protagonist, a second-year at Oumidai Private Academy.
His parents left the country for work a year ago, so he lives alone in an apartment in town.

In the spring of his second year at the academy, an encounter with Izumi led him to begin fighting the creatures known as the Light Hunters.
His ability is Repeat, the power to perceive and match the motion of an object.

His weapon is the Formless Sword, an ever-changing blade.

(from Kagura Games' store page)
